newsitem.title: UK: Internet Tech, Vodafone in tie-up.
newsitem.headline: Internet Tech, Vodafone in tie-up.

text.p: Internet Technology announced on Thursday that it had signed an agreement with Vodata, a unit of Vodafone Group Plc to develop access to Internet electronic mail.
Internet Tech and Vodata would jointly develop a system by which Vodafone GSM phone users would be able to access e-mail services on the Internet.
Subscribers to both Vodafone GSM and Global Internet services will be able to enjoy these facilities anywhere in the world where a GSM roaming agreement with Vodafone is in place.
